svg.title: Pozool Stays ERD
svg.desc: Pozool Stays PostgreSQL entity relationship diagram with a rental lifecycle overview and seven detailed domain panels. It covers all 60 tables and 104 declared foreign keys in the supplied structure.sql. The guest join link is inferred and dashed.
svg.text: Circle = optional · Bar = one · Crow’s foot = many
The overview highlights the rental lifecycle. The detailed panels show company ownership, cross-domain references and supporting tables.

g.text: Listings, reservations, guests, leases and payments
Company ownership, access and application setup
Expenses, cost centers, transactions and operational payouts
Property utility accounts, provider records and tracker runs
Active Storage, galleries and generated documents
Indexing, tagging, audit history and Rails metadata
FK to companies · Repeated company ownership foreign keys are written in each card.
REF · Table detailed in another panel. POLY · Polymorphic key pair. FIELD · Selected column without a declared FK in this schema.
